However, it has high leverage (debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 2.71) and critically weak liquidity (current ratio of 0.63), indicating significant short-term refinancing risk and vulnerability to adverse conditions. These weaknesses outweigh the profitability strengths, placing the issuer in speculative grade territory.

DECISION: BB+
